touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Friskney qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS and Churchyard cross, All Saints churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Friskney: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS
